description: Design enrichment for /setup Stage 7. componentLibraries = pick exactly one (or none). guidelines = cite any. Each entry lists agent resources (mcp/skills/llms/cli) with why. Pointers only - never vendor bodies.

componentLibraries.name: MUI (Material UI)
componentLibraries.why: Mature React component library implementing Material Design. Strong official agent support via MCP and llms.txt so the agent uses current MUI APIs instead of inventing props.

resources.label: MUI MCP server
resources.why: Gives the agent live MUI docs and code-generation tools so answers cite real pages and match your package versions.

resources.label: Material UI llms.txt
resources.why: Machine-readable docs index for agents that prefer llms.txt over MCP.

installRecipe.description: Cite llms.txt URL in AGENTS.md / project rules so agents fetch official MUI docs

resources.label: MUI getting started
resources.why: Human + agent install and usage entry for Material UI.

componentLibraries.name: shadcn/ui
componentLibraries.why: Copy-in React + Tailwind components owned by the repo. Excellent agent tooling (skill + MCP) so the agent installs and composes registry items correctly.

resources.label: shadcn/ui agent skill
resources.why: Project-aware skill (reads components.json) so the agent uses your aliases, base library, and CLI correctly.

resources.label: shadcn MCP server
resources.why: Lets the agent browse, search, and install components from registries via natural language.

installRecipe.description: Init shadcn MCP for Cursor (Owner confirms)

resources.label: shadcn/ui docs
resources.why: Canonical component and theming docs.

componentLibraries.name: HeroUI
componentLibraries.why: React (+ Native) component system with first-party agent skills, llms.txt packs, and MCP for accurate HeroUI v3 code.

resources.label: HeroUI agent skills
resources.why: Installs HeroUI React skills so the agent knows components, themes, and composition patterns.

resources.label: HeroUI llms.txt
resources.why: llms.txt / llms-full / components / patterns indexes for Cursor @Docs and similar.

installRecipe.description: Cite https://heroui.com/react/llms.txt (or llms-full) in agent docs

resources.label: HeroUI MCP server
resources.why: Real-time component docs and source for agents beyond static skills.

resources.label: HeroUI React getting started
resources.why: Primary human/agent entry for React setup.

componentLibraries.name: daisyUI
componentLibraries.why: Tailwind CSS component class library - works across web frameworks. Free official skill; optional paid Blueprint MCP for heavier agent UI workflows.

resources.label: daisyUI free agent skill
resources.why: Free official skill so the agent uses correct daisyUI class names, colors, and themes.

installRecipe.description: Install free daisyUI skill (Owner confirms) - default enrichment

resources.label: daisyUI Blueprint MCP (commercial)
resources.why: Paid official MCP with mandatory UI workflow (setup, rules, architecture, syntax, QA). Propose only if Owner wants commercial tooling - not required.

installRecipe.description: Owner purchases license, then follow Blueprint install guide - do not invent license keys

resources.label: daisyUI docs
resources.why: Component and theme documentation.

componentLibraries.name: Astryx (Meta)
componentLibraries.why: Meta open-source React design system built for humans and agents. CLI writes agent docs; structured component/docs access reduces hallucinated props. Single library - do not mix with MUI/shadcn/etc.

resources.label: Astryx getting started / AI setup
resources.why: Install packages and run CLI init to scaffold AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and agent conventions for this project.

installRecipe.description: Install @astryxdesign/core + theme + CLI, then npx @astryxdesign/cli init (Owner confirms). Follow current getting-started docs - do not invent package names if docs differ.

resources.label: Astryx CLI reference
resources.why: Agent should use astryx component / docs / template commands as the source of truth for APIs.

installRecipe.description: Add npm script astryx pointing at the CLI for reliable agent invocation (per docs)

resources.label: Astryx site / components
resources.why: Canonical product and component overview.

componentLibraries.name: Reshaped
componentLibraries.why: Professional React + Figma design system. Agent path centers on Storybook MCP (per Reshaped v4 AI workflows). Flag commercial license before install.

resources.label: Storybook MCP (Reshaped AI workflows)
resources.why: Reshaped advertises Storybook MCP for coding agents. Follow Reshaped + Storybook MCP docs after Owner confirms commercial access - do not invent install steps.

installRecipe.description: Owner confirms Reshaped license; wire Storybook MCP per current Reshaped/Storybook docs

resources.label: Reshaped docs overview
resources.why: Core concepts, tokens, and React setup for the design system contract.

componentLibraries.name: Carbon Design System
componentLibraries.why: IBM design system with React/Angular/Vue/web components. Carbon MCP + carbon-builder skill give agents accurate Carbon UI - MCP is public preview and may require IBM/early-access signup.

resources.label: Carbon MCP (public preview)
resources.why: Docs/code search and Carbon UI generation for agents. Note access requirements for non-IBMers.

installRecipe.description: Follow Carbon MCP onboarding (IBMid or early-access form) then connect client - Owner confirms access first

resources.label: carbon-builder skill
resources.why: Pairs with Carbon MCP so the agent follows Carbon conventions when generating UI.

installRecipe.description: Install carbon-builder skill per Carbon onboarding docs after MCP access

resources.label: Carbon design system
resources.why: Guidelines, components, and tokens for humans and agents.

componentLibraries.name: Atlassian Design System
componentLibraries.why: Atlassian Design System (Atlaskit) with public llms.txt and ADS MCP. Use as the sole component library when building Atlassian-style React UI - do not mix with MUI/shadcn.

resources.label: Atlassian Design llms.txt
resources.why: Structured index of tokens, primitives, components, a11y, and MCP pointers for agents.

installRecipe.description: Cite atlassian.design/llms.txt (and subset files as needed) in agent docs

resources.label: ADS MCP server
resources.why: Official MCP for tokens, icons, components, primitives, and a11y analysis.

resources.label: Atlassian Design get started
resources.why: Human entry for foundations and components.

guidelines.name: Material Design 3
guidelines.why: Official Material 3 design language. Primary guidelines anchor for Flutter (and useful if using MUI). Cite - does not replace picking a component library when one is needed.

resources.label: Material Design 3
resources.why: Foundations, components, and theming guidelines for Material products.

guidelines.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
guidelines.why: Official Apple HIG for iOS/macOS-feeling products. Strong guidelines when stack is React Native or Flutter iOS - not a React web component library.

resources.label: Human Interface Guidelines
resources.why: Platform patterns, layout, and interaction guidance for Apple platforms.

guidelines.name: Atlassian Design guidelines (cite-only)
guidelines.why: Use when you want Atlassian foundations/content/a11y guidance without adopting Atlaskit as the component library. Prefer the atlassian-design library entry if building with Atlaskit components.

resources.label: Atlassian Design llms.txt
resources.why: Cite for tokens, a11y, and content guidelines without installing Atlaskit.
